title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback (InstructGPT)
description: RLHF alignment — the technique that made GPT-3 into ChatGPT. SFT + reward model + PPO. Smaller aligned models outperform larger unaligned ones on user preference.
authors: Ouyang, Wu, Jiang, Almeida, Wainwright, Mishkin, Zhang, Agarwal, Slama, et al.
